archive.commit_sha_note: DELIBERATELY NULL, AND THIS IS THE POINT OF THE RECORD. The frozen tool requires an archive commit to change EXACTLY artifact_paths UNION source_paths, which puts this receipt INSIDE its own commit -- and a receipt cannot state the sha of the commit it is inside. The real commit_sha and parent_sha go into the queue's archive block AFTER the commit. BATCH-9e3584's two defective archives took the opposite trade: they recorded the true sha in the receipt, at the cost of committing the receipt separately, and the tool refused them. See COORDINATOR-ADJUDICATION-20260811.md section (b).
